name: deepmerge
description: Local patch of deepmerge 4.3.1. Drops __proto__, constructor and prototype keys while merging the source, and stops copying them from the target (GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4, unpatched upstream). This directory is committed on purpose: the file: override in package.json points here, so a clone without it cannot npm install. Delete the override and this directory when upstream ships a fix.
